svg.title: Conservative Victorian fire go or no-go check
svg.desc: A ten-gate Victorian fire decision card. A fire may be considered only when there is no nearby fire threat; the rating is Moderate and every live ban, restriction, closure, land rule and sign permits this exact fire; a supplied public or specifically and currently authorised fireplace is available; wind is below ten kilometres per hour and not rising; the site and three-metre clear area are safe; at least ten litres of extinguishing water is already beside the fire in usable vessels or an immediately usable hose is connected, and that extinguishing water is separate from drinking water the group needs; a turning tool is ready; a capable adult will supervise continuously; a fire is genuinely needed; and a safe exit remains available. Any no or unknown answer means no fire.
svg.text: Fire: every answer must be YES
CURRENT RULES AND CONDITIONS CONTROL
Estimated wording accuracy: 95% for the cited limits; screen untested.
This is a subjective estimate, not a probability of safety.
Check the exact location now. Any NO or UNKNOWN means NO FIRE.
BEFORE MAKING A FLAME, CONFIRM ALL TEN IN ORDER
NO NEARBY FIRE THREAT
No nearby smoke, visible fire or fire warning. If present: NO FIRE.
MODERATE RATING + CURRENT PERMISSION
All live bans, restrictions, closures, land rules and signs allow it.
High, Extreme, Catastrophic, No Rating, unknown or Total Fire Ban: NO.
CURRENTLY AUTHORISED FIREPLACE
Use a supplied public fireplace, or the exact fireplace the current
site rule specifically authorises. Old ring, scar or improvised pit: NO.
LOW, STEADY WIND
Below 10 km/h every time and not increasing. Moving small branches,
moving embers, rising wind or doubt: NO FIRE.
SAFE SITE + FULL CLEAR AREA
Measure 3 m from outer edge in every direction and highest point up.
Fire at most 1 m × 1 m. Tents and spare fuel stay outside.
Fire starter and prepared wood stay outside until needed;
reject litter, roots, slope or an ember path.
USABLE EXTINGUISHING WATER
At least 10 L already beside the fire in usable vessel(s), or an
immediately usable hose. A stream, lake or tank without delivery is NO.
Separate from drinking water the group needs—or NO FIRE.
TURNING TOOL
A suitable non-combustible tool is beside the water.
CONTINUOUS CAPABLE SUPERVISION
An adult stays awake, alert, able to intervene and in constant sight.
GENUINE NEED
Shelter, insulation, ready food or non-fire signals do not solve it.
SAFE EXIT
An exit away from the fire and surrounding hazards remains usable.
ANY NO / UNKNOWN
ALL YES
NO FIRE
Use shelter and insulation.
Eat ready-to-eat carried food.
Use 000, satellite SOS or a PLB.
Signal by whistle, torch, mirror
or bright material—not a signal fire.
Use carried safe water or a route
Chapter 7 currently provides.
A CONDITIONAL SMALL
FIRE MAY BE CONSIDERED
This is not permission to light.
Use the small-fire control card.
Other gate failure: stop fuel and
extinguish while exit remains safe.
Fire spreads or exit threatened:
move first; then 000, SOS or PLB.
WORKING DRAFT — NOT FIELD-APPROVED
